desc:
CHOCOLATEY FLAVOR: Make it a more magical morning with this yummy combination of chocolate flavored marshmallows plus crispy chocolatey cereal pieces

MAGICALLY DELICIOUS: This sweetened corn cereal with marshmallows has 14g of whole grain (at least 48g recommended daily), a good source of calcium, and 12 vitamins and minerals per serving

FUN CEREAL BOX: The back of the box brings fun to family breakfast time by revealing the magical powers that each marshmallow gives Lucky

SCHOOL SNACKS: Beyond a quick breakfast addition, pack a little magic in any lunch box by adding this chocolatey flavored cereal to individual snack bags or homemade cereal bars

CONTAINS: One 10.6 oz box of Chocolatey Chocolate Flavored Lucky Charms Cereal with Marshmallows
features:
Key Features:

Double Chocolate Flavor

Combines chocolate-flavored cereal pieces with chocolatey marshmallows for an extra-rich taste.

Whimsical Marshmallows

Includes iconic shapes that kids love, making breakfast feel magical and fun.

Whole Grain Content

Provides 14 grams of whole grain per serving, supporting a balanced diet.

Vitamins & Minerals

Fortified with 12 essential vitamins and minerals, including calcium and iron.

Versatile Use

Great as a traditional cereal with milk, eaten dry as a snack, or used in fun recipes.

Benefits

Kid-Friendly and Fun

Delicious chocolate flavor and colorful shapes make it appealing for children.

Nutritional Boost

Offers added vitamins and minerals, contributing to daily nutritional needs.

Convenient

Easy to prepare — no cooking required, ideal for quick breakfasts or on-the-go snacking.

Satisfies Sweet Cravings

A treat-like cereal that provides a satisfying chocolatey taste.
ingredients: Whole Grain Corn, Sugar, Corn Meal, Corn Syrup, Cocoa Processed With Alkali, Modified Corn Starch. Contains 2% or less of: Dextrose, Canola and/or Sunflower Oil, Caramel Color, Red 40, Yellow 5 & 6, Blue 1, Annatto Extract, Salt, Gelatin, Cocoa, Natural and Artificial Flavor, Baking Soda. Vitamins and Minerals: Tricalcium Phosphate, Calcium Carbonate, Vitamin C (sodium ascorbate), Iron and Zinc (mineral nutrients), A B Vitamin (niacinamide), Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), Vitamin B1 (thiamin mononitrate), Vitamin A (palmitate), Vitamin B2 (riboflavin), Vitamin B12, A B Vitamin (folic acid), Vitamin D3.
